pytorch.reason: compute ||M^T M - I||_F (distance-to-O3) and its gradient via autograd; gradient magnitude IS the curvature signal of the constraint surface

pyg.reason: not used — curvature bridge is a matrix-level test; no graph message-passing required

z3.reason: UNSAT: curvature > 0 AND matrix is in GL\O (flat region) — structural impossibility; flat GL space cannot carry O(3) constraint curvature

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: symbolic: constraint f(M)=M^T M - I = 0 for 2x2 case; compute gradient df/dM and Hessian Hf at an O(2) point; Hessian is nonzero (curved)

clifford.reason: O(3) in Cl(3,0) is the versor group (unit vectors); curvature proxy = bivector content of commutator [n1,n2] for unit vectors n1,n2 in S^2; nonzero unless parallel

geomstats.reason: SpecialOrthogonal(n=3): sample points; verify they satisfy M^T M = I; proxy sectional curvature via parallel transport

e3nn.reason: not used — curvature bridge is matrix algebraic; no equivariant network required

rustworkx.reason: G-tower DAG annotated with Axis 1 status: {GL: flat, O: curved, SO: curved, U: curved+complex, SU: curved+complex+det, Sp: curved+symplectic}; GL is unique flat node

xgi.reason: not used — curvature bridge is matrix algebraic; no hypergraph topology required

toponetx.reason: not used — curvature bridge is matrix algebraic; no cell complex required

gudhi.reason: not used — curvature bridge is matrix algebraic; no persistent homology required
